confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several aggregator and listing snippets (Expatica Okinawa, Citycost, Worksplorer, Orion Cafe menu) and are moderately supported. Beer and cocktail are weaker: no reliable Naha cocktail price was found, and the beer figure comes from scattered listings and prefecture-level data. Wine is a single wine-bar listing. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not from live listings. Yen values were converted at an assumed 150 JPY per USD because no current JPY rate was retrieved. The RBA figure is from a search snippet of the RBA exchange-rate pages, and the F11 table itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Japanese regional capital with prices between national Japan averages and Tokyo or Osaka levels, benchmarked against Okinawa prefecture aggregator data and Naha-specific listings. Accommodation follows general Japanese budget and business-hotel pricing for a summer peak-season window.
